info.title: bim-review-coordinator browser API
info.description: Coordinator Browser Contract. Generated from bim-review-coordinator/src/contract (zod); do not edit. Covers coordinator-owned routes the browser calls; /api/governance/* and /api/kit/* proxies are owned upstream.

get.summary: Coordinator-visible runtime summary for operator surfaces.

put.summary: Operator live override of the session idle timeout (revision + process epoch guarded).

post.summary: Create a Review Session (explicit create or legacy single-session).

get.summary: Page through archived (closed) Review Sessions with rebuildability.

post.summary: Recreate a closed Review Session from its server-owned ready artifacts (Idempotency-Key required).

get.summary: Browser bootstrap for Kit streaming: canonical trace, WebRTC endpoints, stage composition.

post.summary: Console reports the first real video frame for a session.
Close a Review Session (resumable checkpointed close).

Keep a viewer lease alive and report stage/DataChannel evidence.
